description: Whether address checks work right now, and this workspace's checks this month. `service` is the paid checking service. `ownCheck`: our own check runs first and asks the address's mail server, if that server gives clear answers; what it can't tell, and every address at Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Yahoo, AOL or iCloud, goes to `service`. Each answer counts once, whoever gave it; a retry after the paid service failed counts again. `state` is the paid service's: `working`, `not_set_up` (checks it would answer wait until we set it up), or `on_hold` (`reason`: `service_trouble`, with `retryAt` when we try again, or `service_month_full`). Two reasons are the workspace's own and come first: `on_hold` with `workspace_suspended` means our team suspended it, and with `payment_failed` that its last payment failed. Either way every check that spends the month waits, our own check's included, until the suspension is lifted or a payment goes through. `month`: `used` of `limit` (`null` when the plan has no monthly limit; `used` still counts), and `resetsOn`, the day the count starts over. Read it before starting a batch.
name: get_email_check_setup
title: Get the address check setup
